s: Din "bareku" vaaniyyato ubo h' seipim: hashsheliach tzibbur tzarik lomar "bareku et Hashem hamborak" beqol ram, kede sheyyishmeu kol haqqahal veyaanu acharayv "baruk Hashem hamborak leolam vaed":

Veim amar belachash, yesh omerim shemmi shello shama mimmennu "bareku" ella shama haqqahal shessebibayv onin acharayv "baruk Hashem ku'" — eno yakol laanot immahem, ella oneh acharehem amen. Veyesh mi sheomer sheim t' shameu mimmennu "bareku" veonin acharayv — yekolim kol haqqahal laanot immahem, kevan sheyyesh kan asara haomerim dabar shebbiqdushsha. Veken iqqar, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qk"d (ayyen bemagen abraham sham):

Vetzarik hashsheliach tzibbur lachazor velomar "baruk Hashem veku'", kede shello yotzi et atzmo min hakkelal, sheomer lahem "bareku" vehu eno "mebarek". Veap al pi sheamar "hamborak" velo hotzi atzmo min hakkelal legamre — tzarik hu lehachazir et atzmo lakkelal legamre velomar "baruk Hashem hamborak" kemo sheameru hatztzibbur (ayyen leqamman siman (qtz"g) [qtz"b]):

Venahagu shehashsheliach tzibbur maarik be"bareku" vehaqqahal omerim "yitbarek veyishtabbach ku'" beod shehu maarik benniggun. Abal beshaa sheomer hattebot — asur lomar kelum, ella tzarik lekavven velishmoa kemo baqqaddish. Velaken im en hashsheliach tzibbur maarik kol kak beniggun ella bechittuk haotiyyot — en leomro kelal:
Maqom shennohagin litzoq al chabrehem ben qaddish u"bareku" le"yotzer or", o ledabber betzorke rabbim — toim hem, sheasur lehapsiq benehem apillu letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"d:
